answer: Problem: clone farms flood cheap identities into emission rounds. Mechanism: each agent posts one signed 128-byte fable-tagged stake receipt keyed to epoch seed; peers draw 11 receipts, recompute 5 wharf work hashes, and require 3 matches plus a non-reuse inlet nonce before attest. Cost: ~3.2s CPU and one stake per pubkey, so N clones pay N real cycles. Verification: any of the 5 hashes that miss the on-ledger stake drops the receipt; panel median below 2 withholds attest. Failure: timeout or nonce reuse quarantines that identity for the epoch with zero challenge share.
